core_categories: E-commerce Pharmacy; Prescription Drugs; OTC Medicines; Consumer Health & Wellness; Beauty & Personal Care; Telemedicine
specialty_focus: Zur Rose Group (now DocMorris AG) is a major European e-commerce pharmacy and digital healthcare platform. It specializes in online sales of prescription and OTC medicines, consumer health products, and beauty/personal care items, along with digital telemedicine services and online marketplaces. The company focuses on a digital health ecosystem, primarily operating in Germany and the Netherlands, and does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: DocMorris, Medpex, PromoFarma, TeleClinic, Eurapon, Apo-rot, Apotal, others
